Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using a Strep-tag to pull down EPRS1 and its interactors. While the paper focuses heavily on phosphorylation (Ser999), the MS part described in the methods and PRIDE metadata is a discovery-based interactome study using DDA and LFQ-like intensity ratios, not a phospho-enriched proteomics run (no TiO2/IMAC mentioned for the MS). The phosphorylation was validated via Western Blotting and in vitro kinase assays.
